text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000151 bills 99215 far above risk-adjusted expectation across every complexity tier, including many low-complexity visits, but the documentation sample is too thin to confirm or refute upcoding.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The claims pattern leans toward concern: this provider's 99215 share runs well above the all-provider rate in every complexity band, including patients with zero or one chronic condition. The sampled high-complexity 99215s (e.g., C0076702, C0078474) look expected and are not the concern. Against this, none of the documented claims fell below the billed level, but only four documented 99215s exist, so the clean result cannot be read as support. The noted share of moderate-plus data-reviewed notes with no lab or test line is weak evidence of possible templated documentation, not proof. A reviewer should first request records targeted at the low-complexity 99215 claims and check whether MDM and time are individualized rather than cloned."}
